title: IIT JEE Advanced 2026 — Admission to IITs
title_hi: आईआईटी जेईई एडवांस्ड 2026 — आईआईटी में प्रवेश
summary: JEE Advanced 2026 registration opens for admission to B.Tech programs at Indian Institutes of Technology.

eligibility.education: Must qualify JEE Main 2026 and be among top 2.5 lakh candidates

body_md:
## JEE Advanced 2026

IIT Madras will conduct JEE Advanced 2026 for admission to B.Tech programs at all IITs.

### Number of Seats

Approximately 16,000 seats across 23 IITs.
meta_description: JEE Advanced 2026 conducted by IIT Madras. Registration from April 30 to May 5. Exam on May 18.

updates.title: Registration Opens
updates.body_md: JEE Advanced 2026 registration is now open.
